final_assessment: Created automate-dev-flow from Sal's aim: run a whole program with Sal present only where Sal adds value, seam-chained (regime 2) or autonomous (regime 3). Sal ratified R-adf-1..8: D1 no-chaining, the single-session model and D6's outward-actions rule become granular settings defaulting to today's behaviour, sign-off included; sign-off once per program (autonomous) or per stage (seam-chained); a closed set of six stop conditions; concurrency allowed and decided at architect; not dogfooded (built supervised, first proven on a big non-critical project); the brief written in every mode; context cleared by an engine-run driver launching a fresh session per phase. Goals G0-G7 ratified. Eight stages declared: decision-layer, seam-chaining, program-brief, tripwires, driver, parallel-lanes, release, first-run. CLAUDE.md names the live program.
